data.long_meaning: The name Cherise is derived from the Latin word 'ceresia', meaning 'cherry'. This name was adopted in France during the Middle Ages and means 'dear one', 'precious one'. In the Christian tradition, cherries symbolize the resurrection and eternal life, making Cherise a beautiful and meaningful name for a baby girl. The name Cherise carries the meaning “Dear one, precious one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin.
